content: Kaɗaŋ Yaŋhooɓa Misra
Israayel kurkoh ɗaa, a ɓayya ina a raakee jen a kaɗeeɗa Misra. A reesa Beerseba, a seeƴukka ŋ Koohiŋ baab ɓa Isaahha.
Ŋ wek, Kooh ɓeeɗukka ɗe ŋ heeƴ an : « Yaŋhooɓa ! Yaŋhooɓa ! » A loffa ne : « Ee ! Mi yii kerah ɗa. »
Kooh woosa ɗe ne : « Ñam Kooh, Koohiŋ baab ɗu, kana neƴƴoh kaɗ Misra, ŋ hey pulɗohe cuuɓ angiɗ nga ɗa, ŋ ndaam.
Mi, ŋ haf fo, ŋ hey ɗa ɓende fu kaɗ te ñam na hee ɗa wike. A Yuusufa tufkan kakaan kiŋ ɗa. »
Yaŋhooɓa kurkohha Beerseba, kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ɓayya ɗe, a yi na ɓitiɓ ciŋ ɓa, na komaakciŋ ɓa, ŋ sareet ca Firawnaana eɗohee ne ca haytoh ɓa.
Ɓa ɓayndohha ɗoopaat caŋ ɓa na in ca ɓa raakoh ŋ Kanaan, a kaɗoh Misra ɗaa na ɓi kahan ce jen,
a hunnda na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe na set ciŋ ɗe, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ ɓa kaɗeeɗa.
Ɓi rimkoh ŋ Yaŋhooɓa
Ɓii ɓeɗ rimkoh ŋ Israayel te ɓa hayya Misra : Yaŋhooɓa na saawiŋ ɗe Ruben.
Ruben na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci : Hanook, Pallu, Hesroon na Karmii.
Simeyong na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci : Yemuwel, Yamiin, Ohad, Yakiin, Sohar na Sawul yi yaay ɓa ɓaah nga ɓi Kanaan.
Lewi na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci : Geerson, Kehaat na Meraari.
Yudaa na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci : Seela, Peeres na Seerah. Ɓiŋ ɗe ƴaar ci ɓinooɓi Eer na Onaan, ɓa kaanoh Kanaan. Peeres raakeen kuɓu ƴaar kanak : Hesroon na Haamuul.
Issaakar na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci : Toola, Puwaa, Yob na Simroon.
Sabuloon na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci : Sered, Eloon na Yahleel.
Ɓeem ɓeɗ kuɓuuci Leya na Yaŋhooɓa raakoh Paddan-Aram na kuɓuuciŋ ɓa. Dinaa kuɓkiŋ ɓa ɓitɓi ɓaatu nga ɗah, ɓa nikan ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay na kaahay (33).
Gaad na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci : Sifon, Haggi, Suuni, Esboon, Eeri, Aroodi na Areeli.
Aser na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci : Yimna, Yiswa, Yiswi na Beriya. Ɓaatta nga Serah taambɗoh ɓa ɓitiɓ. Beriya nameen raak kuɓu ƴaar kanak : Heber na Malkiyel.
Ɓeem ɓeɗ kuɓuuci na set ci Yaŋhooɓa raak na Silpa, ñaama Laban eɗee kuɓkiŋ ɗe Leya. Ɓa jen ɓa nikee ndaŋkiyaah na yasna-yino (16).
Yaŋhooɓa na ɓitiice Rasel raakee kuɓu ƴaar kanak : Yuusufa na Benyaamin.
Yuusufa raakka kuɓu ƴaar kanak : Manasse na Efrayim. A raakoh ɓa Misra na ɓitiice Asnat kuɓu Potifera, seeƴkiɗohaŋ kur-taaha na woyse On.
Benyaamin na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci : Bela, Beker, Asbel, Geera, Naaman, Eehi, Roos, Muppiim, Huppiim na Arde.
Ɓeem ɓeɗ kuɓuuci na set ci Yaŋhooɓa raak na Rasel. Ɓa jen ɓa nikee ndaŋkiyaah na nikiis (14).
Daan raakee kuɓu yino teeku Husiim.
Naftaali na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci : Yahce'eel, Guuni, Yeeser na Sillem.
Ɓeem ɓeɗ kuɓuuci na set ci Yaŋhooɓa raak na Bilha, ñaama Laban eɗee kuɓkiŋ ɗe Rasel. Ɓa jen, ɓa nikee yasna-kanak.
Ɓi rimkoh ŋ Yaŋhooɓa te ɓa hunnda na ɗe Misra jen ɓa nikee ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-yino na yasna-yino (66), ne ɓitiɓ ciŋ kuɓuuciŋ ɗe kinndohuuɗi nga ɗah.
Kuɓuuci kanak ci Yuusufa raakoh Misra ɓaatu nga ɗah, ɓa jen, ɓa nikan ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kanak (70). Ɓeem ɓeɗ ɓi rimkoh ŋ Yaŋhooɓa te ɓa nikka na ɗe Misra.
Yaŋhooɓa hotohiɗ na Yuusufa
Yaŋhooɓa tuuƴee Yudaa ŋ Yuusufa ne a adug ɗe ɗiska na woyse Gosen. Wa Yaŋhooɓa na ɓi kahan ce ree Gosen,
Yuusufa nakohha wotiiraŋ ɗe tokɗu, a kaɗta raaka baab ɓa nga, yi nam teeku Israayel. A hot ɗe hot rek, a nuppa, a morgiɗukka ɗe, a fuɗeeɗa in maañiɗ.
Israayel woosa ɗe ne : « Ɗiski wa nik ndii, ŋ miniɗ kaan kotii, laam ŋ hotisiɗ ɗa, te fu yii pes. »
Weɗi Yuusufa woyoh taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe na ɓi kahan baab ɓa ne : « Mi yii kaɗ woya Firawnaana ne taambɗoh ciŋ ngo na ɓi kahan baab ɓoo, ɓa nikee ŋ Kanaan, ɓa hayiɗ ɗiskiŋ ngo.
Ŋ hey ɗe woye ne ɗu niiɗoh pe' na mbaal na inoh te ɗu haytohiɗ ca na raak-raakiŋ ɗu jen.
Firawnaani ɓeeɗuk ɗu, a meekis ɗu ini ɗu na pangke ɗah,
woyaat ɗe ne ɗu niiɗoh, te ina ɗu nikoh komaaki po wi, ɗu inah weɗi, findi caac ciŋ ɗu. Ŋ ineem ɗu hey mine gen Gosen, laam gen na niiɗoh wa in sanguuɗ nga ɓi Misra. »
